chapter_title_en: Prologue: The Classroom Sketches & The Cracked Eggshell
chapter_title_zh: 序章：教室裡的靈寵畫紙與碎裂蛋殼

pages.scene: Penang Tzu Chi San Jie Classroom — Last Coding Class Before Holiday

panels.narration_en: PENANG TZU CHI CLASSROOM — Warm afternoon sunlight pours across the last San Jie coding class before the school holiday.
panels.narration_zh: 檳城慈濟人文教室——溫暖的午後陽光灑落，這是學校假期前最後一堂三捷班程式課。

dialogue.speaker: TEACHER CHEONG
dialogue.en: Before the holiday begins, sketch your dream guardian pet and write your very first Python spell!
dialogue.zh: 放假前，畫下你夢想中的守護靈寵，寫下屬於你的第一道 Python 咒語吧！

panels.art_prompt: Warm Studio Ghibli watercolor classroom in Penang; Teacher Cheong smiling as all 17 San Jie students sketch dream pets at wooden desks.

dialogue.speaker: NG SHUANG
dialogue.en: Look, Uvincc! My deer has aurora light so it can calm storms gently.
dialogue.zh: 學議你看！我的小鹿帶著極光，可以溫柔地安撫風暴喔。

dialogue.speaker: UVINCC
dialogue.en: Awesome! Mine is a sky-pup with cloud ears and a star compass to guide everyone home.
dialogue.zh: 好酷！我畫的是一隻有雲朵耳朵和星羅盤的小天犬，能帶大家平安回家。

panels.art_prompt: Close-up of Ng Shuang and Uvincc smiling over their hand-drawn Stage 1 Baby sketches on paper.

panels.narration_en: Across the room, classmates share colored pencils, fruit snacks, and laughter — teamwork already blooming before any magic begins.
panels.narration_zh: 教室另一頭，同學們互相借彩色筆、分享水果點心與笑聲——魔法尚未展開，團隊情誼早已悄悄萌芽。

dialogue.speaker: GISELE
dialogue.en: Want a sweet star-berry cookie? Sharing makes drawing way more fun!
dialogue.zh: 要吃一塊星莓餅乾嗎？大家一起分享畫畫更開心！

panels.art_prompt: Carlzen, Gisele, Kua Jun Ming, and Lee Ming Hui sharing colored pencils and plant-based fruit cookies at a classroom table.

panels.narration_en: One big San Jie group photo — seventeen young coders holding up seventeen hand-drawn dreams.
panels.narration_zh: 一張溫馨的三捷班大合照——十七位小小程式師高舉著十七幅親手畫下的夢想。

dialogue.speaker: TEACHER CHEONG
dialogue.en: Remember: alone we can only do a little, but together with kindness, we can move mountains! Say Pythonia!
dialogue.zh: 記住：一個人的力量有限，但懷抱善念團結在一起，就能完成大事！一起喊「Pythonia」！

panels.art_prompt: Joyful wide shot of the 17 San Jie students and teachers posing together holding their pet sketches.

panels.narration_en: That night in Penang, seventeen sketches rest safely beside seventeen pillows...
panels.narration_zh: 那天夜晚在檳城，十七張靈寵畫紙靜靜躺在十七個枕頭旁……

dialogue.speaker: NG SHUANG
dialogue.en: Goodnight, little aurora fawn... I wonder what Pythonia really looks like?
dialogue.zh: 晚安，極光小鹿……不知道 Pythonia 真正的樣子是什麼呢？

panels.art_prompt: Peaceful Penang bedroom at dusk; Ng Shuang placing her pencil drawing beside her bedside lamp.

pages.scene: Meanwhile in Pythonia — Years After Hero Kai's Finale vs. Original Bug King

panels.narration_en: MEANWHILE IN PYTHONIA — Several peaceful years have passed since Hero Kai defeated the original Bug King.
panels.narration_zh: 與此同時在 Pythonia——自從凱英雄擊敗初代蟲王後，已經過了數年和平時光。

dialogue.speaker: HERO KAI
dialogue.en: Feel that strange static wind, Ember? Let's patrol the outer ridge together!
dialogue.zh: 餘燼，你感覺到這陣奇怪的靜電風了嗎？我們一起去外圍山脊巡邏吧！

panels.art_prompt: Hero Kai (4.0H Genome v5.0, cobalt-blue eyes, Tzu Chi belt buckle, sword-free) soaring across golden twilight clouds riding Ember the Red Dragon (09B_CH07_RED_DRAGON_4VIEW_CLEAN).

panels.narration_en: Far below in the forgotten crater of the old battle, a lone hooded boy named Vex stumbles upon a pulsing violet shard — the cracked eggshell remains of the first Bug King.
panels.narration_zh: 在遠方早已被遺忘的古戰場隕石坑裡，一位孤單的兜帽少年「維克斯」偶然發現了一片脈動著紫光的碎片——那是初代蟲王殘留的碎裂蛋殼。

dialogue.speaker: VEX
dialogue.en: Still warm... Everyone throws away what's broken. Nobody ever cared about me either.
dialogue.zh: 還有餘溫……大家總是丟棄破碎的東西。從來也沒有人在乎過我。

panels.art_prompt: Moody Ghibli watercolor ruin; lonely boy Vex kneeling in mist, picking up a glowing violet cracked eggshell shard.

pages.scene: Vex's Painful Memory — Abuse, Hunger & Loneliness

panels.narration_en: FLASHBACK — Years of harsh words, empty bowls, and cold rainy nights taught young Vex to lock his heart behind walls of anger.
panels.narration_zh: 回憶——多年來的苛責、空蕩的飯碗與冰冷雨夜，讓年幼的維克斯學會用憤怒把心緊緊鎖起來。

dialogue.speaker: VEX
dialogue.en: Cold... hungry... If nobody shares a seat at the table, I'll build my own power alone!
dialogue.zh: 好冷……好餓……既然沒有人願意為我留一個位置，我就靠自己打造最強的力量！

panels.art_prompt: Muted rain-washed sepia watercolor flashback: young Vex huddled alone outside a warm lit window, clutching a crumpled torn sketchbook, feeling hunger and rejection (poignant, age-appropriate Studio Ghibli tone).

panels.narration_en: In his dim workshop, Vex feeds his bitter, broken childhood sketch code into the cracked eggshell — never realizing what his loneliness is about to wake.
panels.narration_zh: 在昏暗的工作室裡，維克斯將充滿怨恨與錯誤的童年草圖程式碼輸入碎裂蛋殼——卻渾然不知自己的孤單正要喚醒什麼。

dialogue.speaker: VEX
dialogue.en: Why should happy teams win everything? Compile my anger — wake up!
dialogue.zh: 憑什麼快樂的小隊就能擁有一切？編譯我的不甘——甦醒吧！

panels.art_prompt: Vex typing frantic glowing violet broken code around the cracked Bug King eggshell on a stone workbench.

pages.scene: Bug King II Awakens & The 10:17 PM Starlight Summons

panels.narration_en: CRACK!! Fuelled by Vex's broken code and pain, the eggshell erupts — awakening BUG KING II, far stronger than the first!
panels.narration_zh: 轟隆！！在維克斯的錯誤程式碼與傷痛催動下，蛋殼劇烈爆裂——比初代更強大的「二代蟲王」甦醒了！

dialogue.speaker: BUG KING II
dialogue.en: Your lonely code gave me a new crown, boy... Now let's shatter Pythonia's bonds!
dialogue.zh: 你孤單的程式碼賜予了我全新的王冠，孩子……現在，讓我們撕碎 Pythonia 所有的羈絆吧！

panels.art_prompt: Dramatic violet glitch-lightning erupting from the cracked eggshell as Bug King II rises above a shocked Vex.

panels.narration_en: 10:17 PM — Feeling the darkness rise, Pythonia's ancient Starlight answers by summoning seventeen kind-hearted coders from Penang!
panels.narration_zh: 晚間 10:17——感應到黑暗甦醒，Pythonia 古老的星光即刻回應，從檳城召喚十七位懷抱善心的小小程式師！

dialogue.speaker: HERO KAI
dialogue.en: Seventeen golden ribbons! Ember, full speed — we have to catch them before Bug King II strikes!
dialogue.zh: 十七道金色星光！餘燼，全速前進——我們得在二代蟲王出手前接住他們！

panels.art_prompt: Epic double-wide splash: 17 golden starlight ribbons arcing across the night sky toward Pythonia as Hero Kai flies on Ember the Red Dragon.
